BenefitUnlimitedComponent.bdBenefitUnlimitedDescription: Panoramic and full mouth x-rays once every 5 years, bitewing, periapical and occlusal x-rays once every 6 months.
Amalgam or resin fillings unlimited. Crowns limited to 1 per year, 1 crown in 5 years per tooth.
Dentures are covered one per arch every 5 years, including a full denture, a partial denture or an immediate denture and are not applied to the comprehensive maximum plan coverage amount.
